services.desc: There is no better place to bring your staff for a night of fun, laughs, and team building. Located in the heart of downtown on Market Street, we have the perfect location to let your staff experience what Charleston is all about. Our team will make your staff feel comfortable, relaxed, and catered to during their time at Haberdash. At Haberdash, our goal is to provide you with a memorable corporate event that is neither overly complicated or expensive. Let our owner, Kacie, do the planning for you! blurb: Haberdash is a speak easy themed event lounge located in the heart of downtown Charleston! Haberdash was created to host grooms and their groomsmen on the wedding day, however, it is also the perfect space for an event of any type! Haberdash is filled with flat screen TVs, game systems, billiards, shuffleboard, air hockey, foosball, a poker table & more.
